name: silk-background
description: dsh web-profile client plugin: WebGL silk shader background for the Web GUI. v4: the glass effect rides the official theme service (overrideTokens token layers with light/dark pairs); the node half is a no-op. @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules discovers dsh.client, serves /plugins/silk-background/client.js and injects it into the boot manifest; the dsh.bundle.patch declaration lets `dsh plugin --profile web add` wire the entry automatically.
